Bengaluru (Scch-18), Partly Allowing The Claim
Petition For Compensation And Seeking
Enhancement Of Compensation.
 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice N S Sanjay Gowda
 Oral Judgment
1. The claimant, being aggrieved by the exoneration of the liability on the insurer and also regarding the compensation of Rs.2,36,000/- awarded by the Tribunal, is in appeal.
The Tribunal had exonerated the insurer from the liability solely on the ground that there was no valid permit as on the date of the accident.
In other words, it is the case of the insurer that there was a breach of policy condition.

It is settled law that whenever the insurer pleads violation of policy conditions, the insurer would have to nevertheless pay the compensation and thereafter proceeded to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle as per the decision of a Full Bench of this Court in the case of New India Assurance Company Limited vs. Yellavva And Another reported in 2020 ACJ 2560.

entities.text: New India Assurance Company Limited vs. Yellavva And Another reported in 2020 ACJ 2560
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Consequently, the finding of the Tribunal regarding the liability is set aside.
It is ordered that the insurer shall pay the compensation and shall recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.
3. The Tribunal on assessment of the evidence has recorded a finding that the claimant has suffered fracture of lower 1/3rd right fibula with degloving injury.

4. The Tribunal has thereafter awarded the following sums as compensation:

attendant
charges
6. Loss of amenities in life 25,000  Total 2,36,000 5.
As regards the quantum of compensation, the Tribunal on an analysis of the medical evidence has concluded that the claimant has suffered whole body disability at 6%.
In my view, having regard to the fact that the claimant had suffered a fracture of the right fibula, the assessment of the whole body disability at 6% by the Tribunal cannot be found fault with.

As regards the notional income is concerned, the Tribunal has determined the monthly income,
notionally, at Rs.8,000/-.

Since there is no credible documentary evidence to ascertain the actual monthly income, it would be appropriate and prudent to adopt the monthly income determined by Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, which, for the accident of the year 2015, would be Rs.9,000/-.
7.
As the claimant was aged 31 years, a multiplier of '16' would have to be applied.

Consequently, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.1,03,680/-(9,000 x 12 x 16 x 6%) towards 'loss of future income'.
8.
As a consequence, the amount of Rs.26,000/- awarded by the Tribunal towards 'loss of income during the laid up period' would also stand enhanced to Rs.36,000/- (9,000 X 4months).

9. Having regard to the injuries suffered by the claimant, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of NC: 2024:KHC:50745 Rs.40,000/- towards 'pain and suffering' as against Rs.25,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.

3 10.

Having regard to the lasting effects of the injuries on the claimant, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.40,000/- towards loss of amenities, as against the sum of Rs.25,000/-
awarded by the Tribunal.

11. Having regard to the length of the stay of the claimant in the hospital, the claimant would also be entitled to 'conveyance, food and nourishment and attendant charges' at Rs.15,000/- as against the sum of Rs.8,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.

12. The sums awarded as medical expenses by the Tribunal, being based on documentary evidence,
does not call for modification and hence confirmed.

Consequently, the award of the Tribunal is modified and the claimant would be entitled to the following compensation:

Loss of income during 26,000 36,000  5.
 the laid up period  Conveyance, food, 8,000 15,000  6. nourishment, attendant  charges  7. Loss of amenities in life 25,000 40,000

14 . Thus, the claimant is held entitled to the total compensation of Rs.3,09,680/- as against Rs.2,36,000/-, along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its realization.

The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the amount of compensation awarded within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment with liberty to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.
16. The disbursement of the compensation amount shall be in terms of the award of the Tribunal.
This appeal is accordingly allowed in part.
